_comment: TOXICity character names and stat labels. Unlike most games in this repo, almost every one of these is not a translation choice -- game/define_default.rpy already shipped them in Chinese in the original 0.22.0 English release (define k = Character("卡莉") and so on). This file pins them so a future pass cannot split one character across two spellings, and so the choices we DID make (relationship stats, room names) stay put.
_ladies_bathroom_note: "ladies' bathroom" is deliberately NOT pinned to 洗手间. The game uses two different English phrases for two different things: the proper-noun "Ladies' Room" (a specific room the characters talk about by name) and the ordinary "ladies' bathroom". The former is 洗手间 / 女洗手间 depending on register; the latter is always 女洗手间. Only the proper noun is pinned above.
_kept_verbatim: All 17 OST track names in game/options.rpy -- The Spiders Of Battersea Park, Corpse Rot, Black Rose, Terror Drome and so on. Album and track titles are names, not prose; translating them would make the in-game music list impossible to match against the soundtrack.
"Page Up" / "Page Down" in game/screens.rpy -- key names.
The three gag lines in game/dump.rpy -- that file is a developer's scratch script the game never calls (it is wrapped in `if False:` by the patch), so it is left as documentation.

Two profanity lines in game/script3.rpy ("What the fuck!? Marley?", "Hey, whoa motherfucker! What the fuck!?") -- kept in English on purpose so the profanity stays as blunt as the surrounding register.
The leetspeak strings in game/specialscreens.rpy (3r4mThgIn, 3clff0 34+, 4om3 ag@ln) -- those are the in-game "glitch" title cards, deliberately illegible in the original.
Every asset path and internal identifier (/gui/gallery/ach_chapter1_hover.webp, shelley_ch8_sex2, current_movie_ch9_s, ...) -- not player-visible prose.
_kept_verbatim_note: None of the above appear in data/tl_trans.json: the database is built only from literal pairs where the Chinese side actually contains an ideograph, so deliberately-untranslated strings are absent rather than present-and-equal. That means tools/check.py --game toxicity-0220 reports 0 untranslated entries. The list above exists so the next person to sweep for English knows these were looked at and kept.
_banned_is_a_blunt_substring_match: banned is checked with a plain substring search over every value in data/tl_trans.json, so a term that is ALSO an ordinary Chinese word cannot be listed: 爱情, 友谊, 不安, 压力, 爱心 and 情欲 all occur in ordinary prose here (the last one belongs to the mod's own 情欲点 counter, which is a different thing from the Desire stat). Those are pinned by section comment instead. What is banned below are only name/label variants that have no legitimate use: 凯莉 for 卡莉, 南茜 for 南希, 基斯 for 基思 and so on.
_not_pregnant_note: the mod's own label is 未怀孕; two dialogue lines say 没怀孕 instead, which is the same thing in ordinary speech, so it is not banned.
